DO I WANT SOME SKILL BUILDING EXERCISES FOR FUNCTIONS?


```{verbatim .number-lines}
heat_index <- function(       <!-- <1> -->
    temperature,  <!-- <2> -->
    humidity      <!-- <3> -->
  ) {             <!-- <4> -->
    # Algorithm will go here
}
```
1. Signals that we are defining a function which will have the name `heat_index()`.
2. First arg is named temperature
3. Second arg is named humidity
4. Close the parenthesis after `function()` and use curly braces to provide a place for the algorithm.

:::
